email.subject: Saltwater Pros: a couple quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Luis,

I looked at Saltwater Pros Hair Studio's site. Two things are likely costing you bookings: it's not mobile-friendly, so most people searching for a salon on their phone have a hard time even using the page, and there's no way to book online, so anyone who lands there after hours just leaves instead of booking. The footer also looks out of date and hours aren't listed anywhere.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee, no retainer. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and what I'd fix first?

Alex
Northlight Web
